name: GhostPantry
description: GhostPantry is a mobile-first, self-hosted food inventory and expiration tracker for one or more households. It includes phone-camera barcode scanning, shopping lists, quantity management, expiration tracking, and installable PWA support. Maintained by Specter42.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent GhostPantry database and application data. Back this directory up before major changes.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: auto detects HTTPS reverse proxies; use true to force Secure cookies or false for HTTP-only use.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: SQLite database path inside the container.
